title: Pilot: align Nori dialog layouts with the current style
outcome: Improve the shared dialog presentation in Nori App using its existing design system. Inspect DESIGN.md, PRODUCT.md and resources/css/tokens.css in the worker. Read-only baseline inspection found bg-black/80 and shadow-lg in the shared Dialog; existing tokens are --overlay-scrim (36% steel ink light, 60% black dark) and --shadow-dialog. Keep the change bounded to the shared dialog and its stories/tests, with invoice SaveViewDialog changed only if layout needs it. Use the existing apps/app label adeae6ca-42c6-4809-9024-ba86070cf861; do not apply agent-ready or change existing release milestones. The pilot allows at most 30 minutes including planning, 8 total agent calls, one worker at a time, and no automatic main merge. The prepared image provides offline project dependencies through sh /opt/pilot/setup-deps.sh when run from the repository directory. Do not commit generated dependency links, build output or pilot evidence. Acceptance runs the pinned /opt/pilot/check.sh with PILOT_ASSERT_STYLE=1 independently of worker claims.
acceptance: Rendered light and dark dialogs use the existing --overlay-scrim and --shadow-dialog tokens and fit the current visual style.
Desktop and 390px-wide captures show at least 1rem viewport gutters; tall content scrolls vertically and its close button remains visible.
Keyboard focus starts inside the dialog, Tab stays inside it, Escape dismisses it and restores trigger focus.
Existing dialog and invoice Save view tests, dialog Storybook tests and the frontend build pass; invoice saving/filter payload behavior is preserved.
non_goals: Changing backend behavior, global design tokens or unrelated feature dialogs.
Changing issue pickup settings, initiatives, existing release milestones, or automatically merging into main.
